title: People in the Park
text: Today, I go to the park with my mom. I see many people here. Some people are children, and some people are adults. A young person is riding a bike. An old person is reading a book on a bench. I see a man and a woman walking together. Two women are talking near the flowers. A girl and a boy are playing with a ball. A mom is holding her baby. Everyone is happy in the park!

questions.question: Who does the writer go to the park with?
questions.source_sentence: Today, I go to the park with my mom.

questions.question: What is the old person doing?
questions.source_sentence: An old person is reading a book on a bench.

questions.question: What are the girl and the boy doing?
questions.source_sentence: A girl and a boy are playing with a ball.
